questions.question: I have been studying English for three years. I can now understand most of what people say.
options: It's been a long time since I started learning English.
I'm still struggling to understand spoken English.
My progress has been slow, but I've made some good friends along the way.
By next year, I hope to be fluent in English.
questions.answer: It's been a long time since I started learning English.

questions.question: The new restaurant is more expensive than the old one.
options: The prices are about the same.
I think it's cheaper, but maybe it depends on what you order.
It's definitely less expensive, I'm sure of it.
It's worth paying a bit extra for the better service.
questions.answer: The new restaurant is more expensive than the old one.

questions.question: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world.
options: I'm not sure what I'd do if I won the lottery.
I would buy a house and settle down.
I would invest my money wisely and live comfortably.
I would help my family first.
questions.answer: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world.

questions.question: By the time I finish university, I will have been studying for four years.
options: When I graduate, I'll be happy to take a break from studying.
I'm not sure what I want to do after graduation yet.
My family is very proud of my academic achievements so far.
I hope to get a job in my field right away.
questions.answer: By the time I finish university, I will have been studying for four years.

questions.question: It's getting late, and I'm feeling tired. Let's go home.
options: I think we should stay out a bit longer.
I'd rather go to the gym first.
This is exactly what I needed, some exercise before bed.
The movie isn't over yet.
questions.answer: It's getting late, and I'm feeling tired. Let's go home.

questions.question: I was studying for my exam when the phone rang.
options: I had just finished revising for it.
I wasn't preparing for an exam at all.
It was a really important call, so I answered right away.
I'm not sure what day of the week it was.
questions.answer: I was studying for my exam when the phone rang.

questions.question: The weather forecast says there's a high chance of rain tomorrow.
options: I don't think it will be too bad, we can always take an umbrella.
It's unlikely to rain, so let's not worry about it.
We should cancel our plans and stay indoors instead.
I'm sure the sun will come out eventually.
questions.answer: The weather forecast says there's a high chance of rain tomorrow.

questions.question: You look tired. Have you been working hard?
options: Yes, I've had a lot on my plate lately.
No, I'm just feeling a bit stressed out.
Not really, I just need to get some rest.
I'm fine, thanks for asking.
questions.answer: You look tired. Have you been working hard?

questions.question: I would rather be rich than famous.
options: Being famous is more important to me.
I don't think it's possible to have both, but I'd prefer to be happy.
It depends on the situation, sometimes one is better than the other.
Neither of those things really matters to me.
questions.answer: I would rather be rich than famous.

questions.question: By next summer, I will have been living in London for two years.
options: When I move back home, I'll miss the city.
I'm not sure if I'll still live there after that.
It's a great opportunity to learn about different cultures.
My family is coming to visit me soon.
questions.answer: By next summer, I will have been living in London for two years.
